125452.photoTip_en: Capture panoramic shots of southern Seoul and Seongnam from Maebong Peak (582m) around golden hour just before dusk.
125452.localProTip_en: Take the stairs along the Wonteogol trail for the quickest climb, and stop by the hikers' village at the base afterward for crispy pajeon (scallion pancake) and makgeolli.
125452.transitAccess_en: Shinbundang Line Cheonggyesan Station Exit 2, 10 min walk to Wonteogol trailhead

125497.title_ja: 長峰島 甕岩海水浴場
125497.photoTip_en: Frame the crescent shoreline shaded by ancient pine trees against the tidal mudflats during late afternoon low tide.
125497.localProTip_en: Bring water shoes and small gardening tools for clams during tidal ebb, and rent a bicycle near the ferry terminal to explore the scenic coastal roads.
125497.transitAccess_en: Airport Railroad to Unseo Stn, Bus 202 to Sammok Port, then a 40 min ferry to Jangbongdo (village bus to beach)

125498.title_ja: 昇鳳島 イイレ海水浴場
125498.title_zh: 升凤岛 伊日勒海滩
125498.photoTip_en: Snap wide-angle views of the pristine turquoise sea contrasting against the lush shoreline pine forest under midday sun.
125498.localProTip_en: Unlike typical muddy West Coast shores, this beach features fine yellow sand with a gentle slope, making it ideal for safe, quiet swimming without crowds.
125498.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 1 to Dong-Incheon Stn, Bus 12 or 24 to Incheon Coastal Ferry Terminal, then ferry to Seungbongdo (~1 hr 20 min)

125564.photoTip_en: Photograph the grand arch of the North Gate (Bungmun) aligned with the rugged stone ramparts tracing the hillside for dynamic depth.
125564.localProTip_en: Pair your visit with the Ganghwa Dulle-gil trail connecting the fortress gates to discover quaint local tea houses in Ganghwa town center.
125564.transitAccess_en: Direct Bus 3000 from Sinchon Station (Seoul) to Ganghwa Terminal, then local Bus 25 to North Gate entrance

126480.photoTip_en: Position Yeonjuam Hermitage clinging to the sheer cliffside in the foreground while capturing the morning mist drifting over Seoul.
126480.localProTip_en: The rocky summit ridge requires sturdy hiking boots with good grip; starting the trek from Seoul National University's engineering building shaves off substantial uphill distance.
126480.transitAccess_en: Sillim Line Gwanaksan Station Exit 1, directly at the main entrance of Gwanaksan Mountain Park

126482.photoTip_en: Hike up to the rocky summit at sunset for a sweeping panorama of northeastern Seoul bathed in warm golden light. The massive granite outcrops make for dramatic natural podiums in landscape shots.
126482.localProTip_en: Visit the Buramsan Butterfly Garden and Healing Town near the base if you prefer a flat, barrier-free boardwalk stroll filled with seasonal flowers rather than a steep climb.
126482.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 4 Sanggye Stn Exit 1, transfer to local bus Nowon 08 or walk 20 min to the trailhead.

126485.photoTip_en: Snap the iconic N Seoul Tower framed by lush foliage along the wooden deck staircase just below the summit, or capture the sprawling city lights at twilight from the observation decks.
126485.localProTip_en: Avoid peak cable car queues on weekend evenings by taking the eco-friendly Namsan Sunhwan Shuttle Bus (No. 01A or 01B) directly from Chungmuro or Dongguk University stations up to the peak.
126485.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 3/4 Chungmuro Stn Exit 2, then take Namsan Sunhwan Shuttle Bus 01A up to the tower.

126487.photoTip_en: Frame your shot in front of the iconic red-brick facade of the Arco Arts Center, especially during autumn when the horse-chestnut (marronnier) trees turn brilliant shades of gold.
126487.localProTip_en: Surrounded by Daehangno's theater district, this is a prime spot for weekend busking and indie performances; check same-day discount ticket booths nearby for live Korean theater or musicals.
126487.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 4 Hyehwa Stn Exit 2, 2 min walk.

126488.photoTip_en: Visit the glass-walled Samcheong Park Forest Library nestled deep in the woods; photograph through the oversized windows looking out into the dense canopy of trees.
126488.localProTip_en: After exploring Bukchon Hanok Village or Samcheong-dong cafe street, follow the park's tranquil trails upward to connect directly onto the Seoul City Wall trail with far fewer crowds.
126488.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 3 Anguk Stn Exit 2, transfer to Maeul Bus Jongno 02 and alight at Samcheong Park.

126490.photoTip_en: Capture the cherry blossoms lining the broad walking avenues in April, or frame candid moments against the whimsical open-air animal sculptures and musical fountains.
126490.localProTip_en: Admission to the entire park, including the outdoor botanical garden and zoo, is completely free; pack a picnic mat and snacks like locals do on sunny afternoons.
126490.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 7 Children's Grand Park Stn Exit 1, direct park entrance.

126491.photoTip_en: Capture the traditional Supyogyo Bridge framed by weeping willows and seasonal blossoms during late afternoon golden hour.
126491.localProTip_en: Take a short 5-minute stroll to Taegeukdang, Seoul's oldest bakery, to grab their famous handmade Monaka ice cream after wandering the park.
126491.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 3 Dongguk Univ. Stn Exit 6, 1 min walk

126492.photoTip_en: Frame the grandeur of the Jongmyo Shrine outer gate through the tree canopy in autumn when ginkgo leaves turn brilliant yellow.
126492.localProTip_en: Use this lively gathering spot as your transition point between Jongmyo Shrine and the bustling street food alleys of Gwangjang Market nearby.
126492.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 1, 3, or 5 Jongno 3-ga Stn Exit 11, 2 min walk

126495.photoTip_en: Snap low-angle shots along the clear mountain stream with rustic wooden pavilions tucked under Bukhansan's lush valley trees.
126495.localProTip_en: Combine your visit with a seasonal mountain hike, then reserve an outdoor stream-side table to savor authentic Baeksuk (whole boiled chicken with medicinal herbs).
126495.transitAccess_en: Ui LRT Bukhansan Ui Stn Exit 2, 10 min walk or transfer to local bus Gangbuk 01

126499.photoTip_en: Head to the reflective lotus pond framed by large weeping willows and modern outdoor sculptures for scenic, serene portraits.
126499.localProTip_en: Directly connected to the National Museum of Korea, it's the ideal peaceful picnic respite away from city noise after exploring museum galleries.
126499.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 4 or Gyeongui-Jungang Line Ichon Stn Exit 2, 10 min walk

126502.photoTip_en: Capture the monumental granite rock-carved Buddha (Maae Buljwa) in the soft morning mist against Bukhansan’s craggy granite peaks.
126502.localProTip_en: Take advantage of the free temple shuttle bus running regularly from near Bukhansan Ui Station to avoid a steep, uphill mountain walk.
126502.transitAccess_en: Ui LRT Bukhansan Ui Stn Exit 2, then take the free Doseonsa shuttle bus (approx. 10 mins)

126503.photoTip_en: Capture the intricate Buddhist eaves against the forested slopes of Ansan Mountain, especially during midsummer when lotus flowers bloom around the courtyard ponds.
126503.localProTip_en: Headquarters of Korea's Taego Order; if visiting in June, don't miss the Yeongsanjae ritual, a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage event featuring traditional Buddhist chanting and dance.
126503.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 2 Sinchon Station Exit 3, take local bus Seodaemun 03 to the Bongwonsa Temple terminus.

126511.photoTip_en: Photograph the Western-style Grand Greenhouse (Daeonsil) illuminated after sunset, or capture the autumn leaf reflections across the surface of Chundangji Pond.
126511.localProTip_en: Unlike Changdeokgung, regular night entry requires no advance booking and Hanbok wearers enter free. A connecting gate allows easy passage directly into Changdeokgung during the day.
126511.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 4 Hyehwa Station Exit 4, approx. 10–15 min walk.

126514.photoTip_en: Walk up the grassy knoll of Heunginjimun Park at dusk to frame the illuminated fortress gate set against continuous streams of urban car light trails.
126514.localProTip_en: Serves as the starting point for the scenic Naksan Mountain section of the Seoul City Wall trail, leading smoothly toward Daehangno and Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP).
126514.transitAccess_en: Subway Lines 1 or 4 Dongdaemun Station Exit 6 or 7, immediate access.

126516.photoTip_en: Use a low upward angle to contrast the vivid wooden pavilion pillars and massive bronze bell against the surrounding Jongno glass skyscrapers.
126516.localProTip_en: Famous nationwide for the annual New Year's Eve countdown tolling ceremony. On weekdays, stop by around 11:30 AM to catch the traditional midday bell-ringing event.
126516.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 1 Jonggak Station Exit 4, directly outside the exit.

126519.photoTip_en: Shoot during the late afternoon golden hour around the reconstructed thatched pit dwellings framed by native reeds and wildflowers.
126519.localProTip_en: The on-site museum displays original comb-pattern pottery (Jeulmun) from the Neolithic era. Check out the annual Gangdong Prehistoric Culture Festival in October for immersive historical workshops.
126519.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 8 Amsa Station Exit 1 or 4, take local bus Gangdong 02 to Amsa-dong Prehistoric Settlement.

126523.photoTip_en: Head up to the observatory deck at twilight to capture the Han River and 63 Square set against vibrant sunset hues.
126523.localProTip_en: This is one of the best secret vantage points for the annual Seoul International Fireworks Festival without the massive crowds of Yeouido.
126523.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 9 Nodeul Stn Exit 1, 3 min walk

126524.photoTip_en: Frame the towering memorial monument with the rugged peaks of Bukhansan Mountain in the background on a clear morning.
126524.localProTip_en: After paying respects at the memorial hall, take a relaxing stroll up the adjacent 4.19 Cafe Street for artisanal bakeries and leafy garden cafes.
126524.transitAccess_en: Ui-Sinseol LRT Gaori Stn Exit 2, 10 min walk (or 4.19 National Cemetery Stn Exit 2, 15 min walk)

126527.photoTip_en: Capture the solemn Jeongjagak (T-shaped shrine) surrounded by lush ancient pine trees in early morning sunlight.
126527.localProTip_en: Combine your trip with a stroll through the adjacent Hongneung Arboretum, which offers tranquil wooded trails away from city bustle.
126527.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 1 Cheongnyangni Stn Exit 2, transfer to Bus Dongdaemun 05 or walk 15 min

126528.photoTip_en: Photograph the outdoor Stations of the Cross stone sculptures framed by leafy tree canopies and dramatic cliffside views above the Han River.
126528.localProTip_en: Visit the underground martyr exhibition and chapel for a deeply serene atmosphere, then walk down the ramp to seamlessly connect with the Han River walking trail.
126528.transitAccess_en: Subway Line 2 or 6 Hapjeong Stn Exit 7, 7 min walk toward the river
